title_translated: 搜索之后才是难点：在合成、组织和展示知识上对网络智能体进行基准测试
summary_translated: 现有的计算机使用智能体基准测试未能全面评估作为助手的智能体。一个有用的助手需要在复杂的多步骤工作流中跨域检索信息，将其整合为成果（如文档、演示文稿、电子表格），并导航程序界面以生成连贯的最终产品。此类工作流要求推理与综合、复杂任务的分解，以及视觉和空间理解能力。为研究此类工作流中的智能体，我们提出了KNOWS，一个开放式的、复杂的、基于浏览器的任务基准，联合评估这些能力，每个任务最终都会产生一个成果。为了设计任务，我们开发了任务设计规范和确保任务满足要求的协议。每个任务都配有评估器，即一个结合确定性检查与大语言模型判断的程序，以平衡智能体评估中固有的丰富性、可靠性和自动化之间的权衡。我们评估并分析了前沿的计算机使用智能体和基于浏览器的框架。它们在部分成功指标上表现中等，但最佳表现者在我们复杂且长时程的任务中完全成功的比例不足3%。在视觉步骤上的失败导致生成成果无法使用，即使智能体完成了超过50%的其他评估步骤。我们的结果揭示了当前智能体作为端到端助手的局限性，并呼吁在工具使用、视觉理解及长时程推理方面取得进展。

summary: Agent memory systems are increasingly used to maintain long-term user preferences, task states and evolving facts, but current evaluations often collapse memory behavior into final-answer accuracy. We introduce MemProbe, a cognitive-science-inspired framework for diagnosing stability-plasticity tradeoffs in agent memory. The framework is motivated by a core insight from cognitive memory research: memory is reconstructive and shaped by interference, source reliability, reinforcement, and reactivation. MemProbe turns this insight into four reusable experimental paradigms (interference, misinformation, consolidation strength, and reconsolidation window) that manipulate when a memory should be updated, preserved, or treated as uncertain. It further decomposes correctness into behavioral profiles that reveal how systems update, preserve, attribute, and temporally organize information. We instantiate these paradigms in a 56-episode diagnostic suite and evaluate six incremental memory systems under a unified protocol. Results show that systems with similar aggregate scores exhibit distinct behavioral profiles. MemProbe provides such a diagnostic lens, turning aggregate performance into interpretable profiles of memory maintenance over time. Code is available at https://github.com/jq-ding/MemProbe.
title: Probing Stability-Plasticity Tradeoffs in Agent Memory through Cognitive Experimental Paradigms

title_translated: 通过认知实验范式探究智能体记忆中的稳定性-可塑性权衡
summary_translated: 智能体记忆系统越来越多地用于维护长期用户偏好、任务状态和不断演化的事实，但当前的评估往往将记忆行为简化为最终答案的准确率。我们提出了MemProbe，一个受认知科学启发的框架，用于诊断智能体记忆中的稳定性-可塑性权衡。该框架源于认知记忆研究的核心洞察：记忆是重构性的，受到干扰、来源可靠性、强化和再激活的影响。MemProbe将这一洞察转化为四个可重复使用的实验范式（干扰、错误信息、巩固强度、再巩固窗口），用以操控记忆应何时更新、保留或视为不确定。它进一步将正确性分解为行为特征，揭示系统如何更新、保留、归因和时间组织信息。我们在一个包含56个episode的诊断套件中实现了这些范式，并在统一协议下评估了六个增量式记忆系统。结果显示，具有相似总体得分的系统表现出截然不同的行为特征。MemProbe提供了这种诊断视角，将总体性能转化为随时间演变的记忆维持可解释性特征。代码已公开于 https://github.com/jq-ding/MemProbe。

summary: Audience sizing is a critical component of digital marketing. It enables precise resource allocation, campaign planning, and performance optimization. Traditional approaches using skeleton audiences, sampling, or predictive modeling suffer from significant delays, estimation errors, and poor scalability over high-dimensional profile data. We present REALMS (Real-time Exact Audience sizing via LLM-based Multi-attribute Search), a conversational system for exact audience sizing deployed in production on an enterprise customer data platform. REALMS enables marketers to query massive profile stores with millions of profiles and thousands of attributes using natural language and receive precise counts in seconds. The system introduces three key components: (1) a categorical attribute retrieval mechanism using embedding-based vector search to dynamically identify relevant schema attributes without manual configuration; (2) an LLM-powered NL2SQL pipeline with template-based in-context learning for accurate query generation over complex nested schemas; and (3) schema standardization enabling industry-agnostic deployment across diverse enterprise environments. Evaluation on real enterprise data demonstrates strong recall for attribute retrieval, high SQL execution accuracy, and low latency, which enables real-time interactive audience insights where prior methods required hours.
title: REALMS: An AI-Assistant Conversational System for Real-Time Exact Audience Sizing over High-Dimensional Nested Profiles

title_translated: REALMS：面向高维嵌套用户画像的实时精确受众规模估算AI助手对话系统
summary_translated: 受众规模估算在数字营销中至关重要，能够实现精准资源配置、活动规划和绩效优化。传统方法使用骨架受众、抽样或预测建模存在显著延迟、估计误差以及在高维画像数据上的可扩展性差等问题。我们提出了REALMS（基于大语言模型的多属性搜索实现的实时精确受众规模估算），一个部署在企业客户数据平台上的对话式系统。REALMS使营销人员能够通过自然语言查询包含数百万条画像和数千个属性的大型画像库，并在数秒内获得精确计数。该系统引入了三个关键组件：(1) 基于嵌入向量搜索的分类属性检索机制，无需手动配置即可动态识别相关模式属性；(2) 基于大语言模型的NL2SQL管道，采用基于模板的上下文学习，在复杂嵌套模式上实现准确查询生成；(3) 模式标准化，支持在不同企业环境中实现行业无关的部署。在真实企业数据上的评估表明，属性检索具有强召回率，SQL执行准确率高，延迟低，从而实现了此前需数小时才能完成的实时交互式受众洞察。

summary: Children in multilingual communities often code-switch, using multiple languages in a single utterance. Can we induce cross-lingual alignment in language models by training on code-switched text? We pretrain small decoder-only transformers on two 100M-word multilingual corpora: a base corpus formed by mixing the English, Dutch, and Chinese BabyBabelLM datasets, and a corpus generated from it by inserting word- and sentence-level code-switching using an LLM. We find that training on code-switched data aligns the representations of parallel text, particularly across different scripts, and that this alignment persists through training on monolingual documents. Under a learning curriculum that progresses from word-level code-switching, to sentence-level code-switching, to monolingual documents, models trained on code-switched data outperform baselines trained without it on the BabyLM evaluation suite. Our work characterizes code-switching curriculum learning as an effective data augmentation method for multilingual pretraining. We release our code, data, and models at https://github.com/drooryck/multilingual-macaroni.
title: Feeding BabyLMs Macaroni: Code-Switching Curricula Cause Cross-Lingual Convergence
comment: 17 pages, 8 figures. Accepted to the BabyLM Workshop at EMNLP 2026
title_translated: 喂养BabyLMs意大利面：语言切换课程引发跨语言收敛
summary_translated: 在多语言社区中，儿童经常进行语言切换，即在同一语句中使用多种语言。我们能否通过在语言切换文本上训练来诱导语言模型中的跨语言对齐？我们在两个各含1亿词的多语言语料库上预训练小型仅解码器Transformer模型：一个基础语料库由英语、荷兰语和中文的BabyBabelLM数据集混合而成，另一个语料库则通过使用大语言模型在其中插入词级和句级语言切换生成。我们发现，在语言切换数据上训练能对齐平行文本的表示，特别是跨不同书写系统的文本，且这种对齐在后续单语文档训练中仍能保持。在从词级语言切换、到句级语言切换、再到单语文档的学习课程中，经过语言切换训练的模型在BabyLM评估套件上的表现优于未经过此类训练的基线模型。我们的工作将语言切换课程学习描述为一种有效的多语言预训练数据增强方法。代码、数据和模型已发布于 https://github.com/drooryck/multilingual-macaroni。

summary: Voice agents are increasingly deployed in workflows where failed interactions can affect transactions, access, and other consequential outcomes, creating a need for reproducible and interpretable evaluation. We introduce Inquesto Score (IS), a protocol for measuring voice-agent reliability as the percentage of calls in a fixed, versioned evaluation population that achieve the caller's goal without a functional failure or worse. Rather than combining heterogeneous metrics, IS defines explicit failure events and severity levels and evaluates the deployed voice pipeline. Timing failures, including talk-over and delayed responses, are measured directly from audio, while semantic and state-dependent failures are evaluated using scenario predicates, tool traces, and a pinned open-model judge. Diagnostic views of behavior, acoustic robustness, identity handling, and speaker groups accompany the score without being combined into it. Inquesto Score v0.1 evaluates 30 scenarios, three acoustic conditions, four speaker groups, and 306 calls per agent across 13 configurations of a reference voice-agent system. Our evaluation shows that reliable measurement requires evidence beyond transcripts, explicit treatment of deployment conditions, and validation of the evaluators used to determine outcomes. We release the protocol, reference implementation, and evaluation records.
title: Inquesto Score: A reliability Protocol For Voice Agents
title_translated: Inquesto评分：语音智能体的可靠性评估协议
summary_translated: 语音智能体正被越来越多地部署在失败交互可能影响交易、访问及其他重要结果的工作流程中，因此亟需可复现且可解释的评估方法。我们提出了Inquesto Score（IS），一种衡量语音智能体可靠性的协议，定义为在固定、版本化的评估群体中，达成呼叫者目标且无功能故障或其他更严重问题的通话比例。IS不合并异构指标，而是明确定义故障事件及其严重等级，并对已部署的语音处理链路进行评估。时间类故障（包括打断和响应延迟）直接从音频中测量，而语义和状态依赖性故障则通过场景谓词、工具追踪和固定开放模型评判员进行评估。伴随评分提供诊断视图，涵盖行为、声学鲁棒性、身份处理和说话人组别，但这些不被合并进评分本身。Inquesto Score v0.1评估了30个场景、三种声学条件、四类说话人组别，以及在一个参考语音智能体系统13种配置下的每智能体306通电话。我们的评估表明，可靠的测量需要超越转录文本的证据，明确对待部署条件，并验证用于确定结果的评估者。我们发布了该协议、参考实现和评估记录。

summary: Language models often produce homogeneous responses to open-ended tasks; such homogeneity can spawn groupthink-the convergence of ideas toward a singular and potentially suboptimal decision. We formulate persona diversification as a set-level conditioning problem and study two orthogonal design choices: selecting versus generating personas, and space-filling versus frontier-seeking diversity. We instantiate this design space with four methods spanning coverage and dispersion subset selections, uniform-coverage sampling, and evolutionary persona generation. Evaluations on the Alternative Uses Task (AUT), Infinity-Chat, and Divergent Association Task (DAT) show the benefits of the proposed methods across tasks and creativity objectives. On AUT, evolutionary persona generation increases response diversity by 78.8%, originality by 26.1%, flexibility by 49.5%, and holistic creativity by 13.9% over task-only prompting, while maintaining 98.5% validity; on Infinity-Chat, it nearly doubles persona-induced response separation relative to random personas. Moreover, evolutionary personas compose with creativity-optimized prompting, further increasing its response diversity by 18.6% and creativity by 6.3%. These results establish persona-set geometry as a task-agnostic mechanism for eliciting divergent LLM outputs, and support persona diversification as a reusable complement to prompt optimization.
title: Breaking Homogeneity: Diversifying Persona Sets for Creative LLM Outputs
title_translated: 打破同质性：用于创意LLM输出的个性集合多样化
summary_translated: 语言模型在开放式任务中常常产生同质化的响应；这种同质性可能引发群体思维——思想趋向单一且可能次优的决策。我们将个性多样化建模为集合级条件问题，并研究了两种正交的设计选择：选择与生成个性，以及空间填充与前沿探索式多样性。我们通过四种方法实例化这一设计空间，涵盖覆盖与分散的子集选择、均匀覆盖采样和进化个性生成。在替代用途任务（AUT）、Infinity-Chat和发散联想任务（DAT）上的评估表明，所提方法在不同任务和创意目标下均具优势。在AUT任务中，进化个性生成相比仅任务提示使响应多样性提升78.8%，原创性提升26.1%，灵活性提升49.5%，整体创造力提升13.9%，同时保持98.5%的有效性；在Infinity-Chat中，其使个性诱导的响应分离度接近翻倍，优于随机个性。此外，进化个性与创意优化提示结合，进一步使响应多样性提升18.6%，创造力提升6.3%。这些结果确立了个性集合几何作为激发LLM差异化输出的任务无关机制，并支持个性多样化作为提示优化的可复用补充。

summary: Reference-based LLM-as-a-judge evaluation assumes the reference answer is the target. In deployed agentic systems that operate over dynamic entities (support cases, assets, accounts), the closest available reference typically applies the correct procedure to a different entity, so a literal judge penalizes different identifiers, dates, and statuses as errors or hallucinations. We name this failure mode reference-instance divergence (RID). We propose CARGO, a framework that (i) treats retrieved references as procedural exemplars and grounds factual judgments in the live instance's observed context, (ii) assigns each claim a three-way status (supported, contradicted, unverifiable) and penalizes only contradictions, and (iii) gates evaluation by retrieval confidence, casting production evaluation as selective prediction. We introduce CARGO-Bench, a perturbation-based diagnostic suite with ground truth by construction that separates leniency from discrimination. On CARGO-Bench (246 items, two judge models, 7,872 judgments), the standard reference-based judge penalizes 100% of correct entity-transplanted answers and is uninformative (discrimination index DI ~ 0); supplying the live facts without reframing changes nothing. CARGO eliminates these false penalties (0/50) while retaining near-complete contradiction recall (50/50 and 49/50), raising DI to 0.58 [0.48, 0.68]; a rubric-swap control attributes most of the effect to context-grounded dimension definitions. CARGO also exposes a limitation of its own design: the leniency that protects entity values suppresses detection of procedural corruptions (20% recall). A post-hoc fix does not close the gap, and an LLM-as-annotator study with written guidelines and adjudication shows the same blind spot. We release a preregistered protocol for extending the evaluation to expert agreement, risk-coverage, and cost on production traffic.
title: CARGO: Context-Aware Retrieval-Gated Evaluation of Agentic AI in Production

title_translated: CARGO：面向生产环境中智能体AI的上下文感知检索门控评估
summary_translated: 基于参考答案的LLM作为裁判评估假设参考答案即为目标。但在部署的智能体系统中，若操作对象为动态实体（如支持案例、资产、账户），最接近的参考通常适用于不同实体的正确流程，因此字面裁判会将不同的标识符、日期和状态误判为错误或幻觉。我们称此失败模式为参考实例偏差（RID）。我们提出CARGO框架，(i) 将检索到的参考视为程序范例，并将事实判断基于实时实例的观测上下文，(ii) 为每个陈述分配三类状态（支持、矛盾、不可验证），仅惩罚矛盾，(iii) 以检索置信度为门控，将生产环境评估转化为选择性预测。我们引入CARGO-Bench，一个基于扰动的诊断套件，其真值由构造决定，能区分宽容性与歧视性。在CARGO-Bench（246项，两个裁判模型，7,872次判断）上，标准参考基准裁判对所有正确实体移植的答案均100%惩罚，且无信息量（区分指数DI ~ 0）；提供实时事实但不重构内容亦无改善。CARGO消除了这些虚假惩罚（0/50），同时保留近乎完整的矛盾召回率（50/50和49/50），将DI提升至0.58 [0.48, 0.68]；对照实验表明，大部分效果源于上下文锚定的维度定义。CARGO也暴露了自身设计的局限性：保护实体值的宽容性抑制了对流程缺陷的检测（20%召回率）。事后修复无法弥合差距，且使用书面指南和仲裁的LLM标注员研究也显示出相同盲点。我们发布了预注册协议，用于扩展评估至专家一致、风险覆盖和生产流量成本。

summary: Retrieval-based factuality evaluation, where LLM-generated claims are verified against evidence from authoritative medical corpora, has become the dominant paradigm for scalable hallucination detection in high-stakes clinical settings. Despite the urgency of reliable and transparent medical fact verification, most systems measure performance with aggregate metrics like F1, which obscure where and why failures occur. Existing RAG diagnostics require gold answers or annotated gold evidence, neither of which exists in this regime. We introduce two comprehensive taxonomies, grounded in a case study on the open-ended MedExpert dataset and 3 closed-ended datasets, decomposing failures into retrieval-stage errors along five quality dimensions, and verifier-reasoning errors into six consecutive steps. We adapt an automatic pattern induction pipeline using LLM-as-Judge to label evidence quality and classify verifier reasoning errors at scale, and then stress-test our findings across 4 retrieval methods and 6 frontier verifier models. Our analysis reveals that scaling model size, adding reasoning effort, expanding to authoritative web sources, and applying medical fine-tuning do not resolve these failure modes, demonstrating that they represent fundamental limitations of the retrieve-then-verify paradigm in open-ended medical settings rather than artifacts of outdated systems. We release our code and data at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Medical_RAG_eval-4AB5 for the full reproducibility of our results.
title: Where Does Retrieval-Based Open-Ended Evaluation Fail? Automatic Taxonomy Induction from Long-Form Medical Answer Factuality Verification

title_translated: 基于检索的开放式评估在何处失效？从长篇医学回答事实性验证中自动归纳分类体系
summary_translated: 基于检索的事实性评估——即利用权威医学语料库中的证据验证LLM生成的陈述——已成为高风险临床场景中可扩展幻觉检测的主流范式。尽管可靠透明的医学事实验证至关重要，但大多数系统仍依赖F1等聚合指标，掩盖了失败的具体位置与原因。现有RAG诊断方法需要真实答案或标注的真实证据，而此类数据在此场景中并不存在。我们提出了两个全面的分类体系，基于对开放式MedExpert数据集及三个封闭式数据集的案例研究，将失败分解为五个质量维度的检索阶段错误，以及六个连续步骤的验证器推理错误。我们采用基于LLM作为裁判的自动模式归纳流程，在大规模上标注证据质量并分类验证器推理错误，随后在四种检索方法和六种前沿验证器模型上进行压力测试。分析表明，模型规模扩大、增加推理努力、扩展至权威网络来源、应用医学微调均无法解决这些失败模式，证明它们是开放医学场景下“检索-验证”范式的根本局限，而非过时系统的产物。我们已在https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Medical_RAG_eval-4AB5发布代码与数据，确保结果完全可复现。

summary: We introduce target-speaker unlearning ASR (TSU-ASR) task in a fully end-to-end framework for multi-speaker ASR and diarization. Given a multi-speaker utterance and a set of opt-out speakers who do not wish to have their speech transcribed, the task requires an ASR system to transcribe all speakers except the opt-out ones, while still indicating when those speakers are active. As a first step towards tackling this task, we introduce a novel, light-weight Enrollment-Conditioned Gating (ECG) module attachable to a frozen dual-stream speech LLM that enables ASR for new opt-out speakers dynamically during inference, even those who were not seen during initial ECG training phase. Our experiments on both AMI (English) and AliMeeting (Mandarin) datasets show that speech transcription accuracy for corresponding opt-out words or characters falls from 72.3% to 48.2% and from 73.6% to 27.3%, respectively, while retained speakers' transcription error rates maintain more or less the same. Our approach provides a practical solution for modern video conferencing platforms, allowing speakers to dynamically opt-out from automated AI transcriptions without forcefully leaving the meeting sessions, enabling a privacy-preserving interface for potentially millions of online meetings daily.
title: Inference-Time Target Speaker Unlearning in LLM-Based Automatic Speech Recognition

title_translated: 基于LLM的自动语音识别中推理时目标说话人遗忘
summary_translated: 我们提出了一种全端到端多说话人ASR与语音分割框架下的目标说话人遗忘ASR（TSU-ASR）任务。给定一个多说话人语句和一组不愿被转录的说话人名单，该任务要求ASR系统转录除指定说话人外的所有人，同时仍需指示这些说话人何时发言。作为迈向该任务的第一步，我们引入一种轻量级的注册条件门控（ECG）模块，可附加于冻结的双流语音LLM之上，实现在推理过程中动态地为新出现的拒绝转录说话人提供支持，即使这些说话人未在初始ECG训练阶段出现。在AMI（英语）和AliMeeting（中文）数据集上的实验显示，对应拒绝转录说话人的语音转录准确率分别从72.3%降至48.2%，从73.6%降至27.3%，而保留说话人的转录错误率基本不变。我们的方法为现代视频会议平台提供了实用解决方案，使说话人可在不强制退出会议的情况下动态选择不参与AI转录，从而为每日数百万在线会议提供隐私保护接口。

summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown strong performance in low-resource offline translation; however, extending them to simultaneous speech-to-speech translation (Simul-S2ST) remains challenging due to the scarcity of causally aligned training data with high cross-lingual speaker fidelity. In addition, existing approaches rely on fixed translation policy or confidence heuristics, leading to suboptimal quality and higher latency. We propose a causality-aware Simul-S2ST framework with a novel data pipeline that generates high-fidelity, causally aligned segments with improved voice transfer. The framework introduces (i) a factorized S2ST architecture (FAST), (ii) a causality-aware adaptive policy (CAP), and (iii) causality-aware latency metric. Experiments on CVSS Spanish, German, and French show that FAST-CAP consistently improves the quality-latency trade-off, achieving up to +1.2 BLEU and a 26% relative latency reduction over a fixed policy. Despite using substantially less training data than existing systems, FAST-CAP achieves state-of-the-art results in speech translation quality and speaker fidelity while yielding up to a 38.8% relative reduction in latency.
title: All In Good Time: Causality-Aware Framework for LLM-Based Simultaneous Speech-to-Speech Translation
title_translated: 一切恰逢其时：面向LLM的同步语音到语音翻译的因果感知框架
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在低资源离线翻译中表现出色；然而，将其扩展至同步语音到语音翻译（Simul-S2ST）仍面临挑战，主要由于缺乏具有高跨语言说话人保真度的因果对齐训练数据。此外，现有方法依赖固定翻译策略或置信度启发式规则，导致质量欠佳且延迟较高。我们提出一种因果感知的Simul-S2ST框架，包含新颖的数据管道，可生成高保真、因果对齐的片段并改进语音传递。该框架引入(i) 分解式S2ST架构（FAST），(ii) 因果感知自适应策略（CAP），以及(iii) 因果感知延迟度量。在CVSS西班牙语、德语和法语数据集上的实验表明，FAST-CAP持续改善质量-延迟权衡，最高实现+1.2 BLEU得分和26%相对延迟降低，优于固定策略。尽管训练数据远少于现有系统，FAST-CAP在语音翻译质量和说话人保真度上达到顶尖水平，同时延迟最多降低38.8%。

summary: Cognitive psychology has studied how people encode, use, and learn concepts that describe categories, and how they represent, recognize, and acquire chunks for familiar patterns of elements. The literatures on these two topics are nearly disjoint, which poses a challenge for unified theories of cognition. In this paper, we review Cobweb, a computational account of categorization and concept formation, and propose an extended theory that incorporates chunks and their acquisition. The theory makes no commitments about modality, applying to any experience that decomposes into elements and relations among them. We also present \trellis/, an implementation of this theory, and illustrate its application to learning context-free grammars, which we adopt as a testbed because they involve both concept-like and chunk-like elements. In addition, we report experimental results on three synthetic grammars that demonstrate the system's ability to represent syntactic knowledge, use it to parse and generate sentences, and learn compositional structures from sample parses. We conclude by discussing related work on concepts and chunks, along with directions for future research in the area.
title: A Unified Account of Concepts and Chunks

title_translated: 概念与块的统一解释
summary_translated: 认知心理学研究了人们如何编码、使用和学习描述类别的概念，以及如何表示、识别和获取熟悉元素模式的块。这两个主题的研究文献几乎彼此独立，给认知的统一理论带来了挑战。本文回顾了Cobweb这一关于分类和概念形成的计算模型，并提出了一个扩展理论，将块及其获取过程纳入其中。该理论不依赖于特定模态，适用于任何可分解为元素及其关系的经验。我们还介绍了trellis/，该理论的一个实现，并展示了其在学习上下文无关语法中的应用，我们选择这些语法作为测试平台，因为它们同时包含类似概念和类似块的元素。此外，我们在三个合成语法上报告了实验结果，证明了系统能够表示句法知识，利用它进行句子解析和生成，并从样本解析中学习组合结构。最后，我们讨论了与概念和块相关的研究工作，以及该领域未来的研究方向。

summary: Systematic reviews (SR) are essential for evidence-based research, but their screening phase is highly time-consuming and labor-intensive. Large language models (LLMs) offer a promising opportunity to reduce this workload by assisting with article relevance classification. However, existing evaluation approaches often rely on traditional metrics that may be misleading for highly imbalanced SR screening datasets.This paper presents a benchmark dataset of $45\,064$ labeled entries for evaluating LLM performance in SR screening across 32 curated secondary studies. It proposes an evaluation framework that accounts for class imbalance, i.e., the natural prevalence of excluded articles relative to included articles in SRs. It also introduces PromptSR, a tool designed to support prompt experimentation, experiment management, and result analysis for LLM-based screening. We also present a use case demonstrating the application of SRBench and PromptSR.
title: A Benchmark Framework for Screening Automation in Systematic Reviews
title_translated: 系统性综述自动化筛选的基准框架
summary_translated: 系统性综述（SR）对于循证研究至关重要，但其筛选阶段非常耗时且劳动密集。大型语言模型（LLMs）提供了通过辅助文章相关性分类来减轻这一工作量的前景。然而，现有的评估方法往往依赖于传统指标，这些指标在高度不平衡的SR筛选数据集上可能具有误导性。本文提出一个包含45,064个标注条目的基准数据集，用于评估LLM在32个精选二次研究中的SR筛选表现。该框架考虑了类别不平衡问题，即系统性综述中被排除文章相对于被纳入文章的自然比例。同时，本文引入PromptSR工具，支持提示实验、实验管理和结果分析。我们还展示了一个使用案例，说明SRBench和PromptSR的应用。

summary: Conversational recommendation agents are a new paradigm for content discovery, enabling users to express complex intents through natural language (e.g., "recommend Italian indie artists I haven't heard before"). A central challenge in building such agents is optimizing agent planning -- deciding how to select, sequence, and invoke tools -- particularly in cold-start settings where real user interactions are not yet available. We introduce a pipeline for multi-turn synthetic data generation and a self-improvement loop to address this challenge. The synthetic data pipeline transforms single-turn prompts into realistic multi-turn conversations, enabling systematic evaluation before launch. The self-improvement loop combines variance-based contrastive optimization with iterative refinement through a coding agent, automatically identifying and fixing planning and tool-use errors. Our approach improves quality by +8% on top of a highly optimized manual prompt. The system has been productionized and significantly accelerated iteration cycles for the launch of a conversational recommendation agent at Spotify. Online A/B tests demonstrate its effectiveness, with +14% user listening, +5% increase in weekly active users, and a 5% reduction in skip rate compared to a prior experience supporting only session refinement. This work provides a practical framework for accelerating the development of conversational recommendation agents in industry.
title: Bootstrapping Conversational Recommendation Agents At Spotify: Synthetic Data Generation and Self-Improvement Loops
title_translated: 在Spotify启动对话式推荐代理：合成数据生成与自我改进循环
summary_translated: 对话式推荐代理是一种新的内容发现范式，使用户能够通过自然语言表达复杂意图（例如，“推荐我从未听过的意大利独立艺术家”）。构建此类代理的核心挑战在于优化代理规划——决定如何选择、排序和调用工具，尤其是在没有真实用户交互数据的冷启动场景下。我们提出了一套多轮合成数据生成流水线和一个自我改进循环来应对这一挑战。合成数据流水线将单轮提示转化为真实的多轮对话，从而在发布前实现系统性评估。自我改进循环结合基于方差的对比优化与通过编码代理进行的迭代优化，自动识别并修复规划和工具使用错误。我们的方法在高度优化的手动提示基础上提升了8%的质量。该系统已投入生产，显著加速了Spotify对话式推荐代理的迭代周期。在线A/B测试表明其有效性：用户听歌量提升14%，每周活跃用户增加5%，跳过率降低5%，相比仅支持会话优化的先前体验有明显改善。本工作为工业界加速对话式推荐代理的开发提供了一个实用框架。

summary: Identifying an unfamiliar sign is difficult when a learner remembers its movement but does not know its meaning or formal feature codes. SignTrace addresses this longstanding reverse-lookup problem through natural-language access to a Chinese sign-language dictionary. The system integrates LLM-based dictionary enrichment, action extraction, dictionary-style rewriting, seven-channel retrieval, and candidate reranking over 6,699 entries. It has been deployed for user trials and has received positive informal feedback. Evaluation on a dictionary-derived benchmark of 500 movement-description queries yields 94.0% Hit@1, 97.4% Hit@9, and a mean reciprocal rank of 0.9540. Reranking increases Hit@1 from 71.8% to 94.0%, while component analyses show the contribution of enriched entry descriptions. Median query-processing time is 13.37 seconds with six concurrent queries. By connecting everyday movement descriptions to documented signs and meanings, SignTrace provides a practical tool for identifying unfamiliar signs. Dictionary-derived wording and prior selection within the benchmark limit generalization to descriptions independently produced by users.
title: SignTrace: Describe a Sign, Find the Word

title_translated: SignTrace：描述一个手势，找到对应的词
summary_translated: 当学习者记得某个陌生手势的动作却不知道其含义或正式特征编码时，识别该手势十分困难。SignTrace通过自然语言访问中文手语词典，解决了这一长期存在的逆向查找问题。该系统整合了基于大语言模型的词典增强、动作提取、词典式重写、七通道检索以及对6,699个条目进行候选重排序。系统已部署用于用户试用，并获得了积极的非正式反馈。在基于词典的500个动作描述查询基准测试中，Hit@1达到94.0%，Hit@9达到97.4%，平均倒数排名为0.9540。重排序将Hit@1从71.8%提升至94.0%，组件分析显示了增强条目描述的贡献。中位查询处理时间为13.37秒，支持六次并发查询。通过将日常动作描述与已记录的手势及意义相连接，SignTrace为识别陌生手势提供了实用工具。然而，基于词典的表述方式和基准中预先选定的选择限制了其对用户独立生成描述的泛化能力。

summary: Scientific presentations are more than summaries of research papers. They need to present the work in a coherent sequence, explain the main ideas clearly, and help the audience follow the presentation. We present SlideLab, a training-free multi-agent framework for generating scientific presentations from research papers. SlideLab first plans the presentation narrative, then builds and iteratively refines a shared slide deck using agents for content planning, visual generation, layout refinement, and grounding verification. In a blind human preference study, SlideLab was preferred over both open-source and commercial systems on 77% of papers while using roughly 4 times fewer inference tokens than the strongest open-source baseline. We also introduce ConfArena, an audience-oriented evaluation framework that simulates a conference room and assesses presentations slide by slide. ConfArena matches human system rankings and detects injected presentation problems, including falsified numbers, degraded figures, dropped slides, and shuffled slide order.
title: SlideLab: Audience-Centered Scientific Slide Generation and Evaluation

title_translated: SlideLab：以观众为中心的科学幻灯片生成与评估
summary_translated: 科学演示不仅仅是研究论文的摘要。它们需要以连贯的顺序呈现工作内容，清晰地解释核心思想，并帮助观众跟上讲解节奏。我们提出了SlideLab，一种无需训练的多智能体框架，用于从研究论文生成科学演示文稿。SlideLab首先规划演示叙事，然后通过内容规划、视觉生成、布局优化和接地验证等智能体共同构建并迭代优化共享幻灯片集。在盲测的人类偏好研究中，SlideLab在77%的论文上优于开源和商业系统，同时使用的推理token数量仅为最强开源基线的约四分之一。我们还引入了ConfArena，一种以观众为导向的评估框架，模拟会议现场，逐页评估演示文稿。ConfArena能匹配人类对系统的评分，并检测出注入的演示问题，包括伪造数据、退化的图表、缺失幻灯片和幻灯片顺序错乱。

summary: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) enables AI agents to discover and call tools, but loading every definition becomes expensive as connected catalogs grow. We present Cartograph, a federated MCP proxy that changes agent-visible tool discovery from $O(n)$ catalog traversal to $O(k)$ progressive disclosure. Cartograph combines three mechanisms: (1) operator-attested capability cards, Ed25519-signed descriptions generated under the deploying operator's control rather than ranked publisher copy; (2) Rift, a three-layer confusable-cluster analysis comprising density clustering, query-margin analysis, and token diagnosis; and (3) two-stage retrieval, which ranks servers before tools. On a 22-server, 374-tool deployment, Cartograph exposes three proxy tools instead of 374 definitions. A 49-query author-constructed benchmark yields R@5 of 0.816, compared with 0.592 for a Jaccard keyword baseline, while a measured top-5 discovery exchange uses 475 tokens rather than 42,450 under the stated full-catalog accounting. Rift identifies 49 confusable clusters, including four HIGH-risk clusters in bootstrap-generated cards. An exploratory comparison of 119 LLM-generated descriptions removes the observed zero-distance cluster but shows that mixing card-generation regimes can reduce R@5. Gateway measurements over ten trials add 5ms mean latency (0.8%) relative to direct stdio MCP calls. Cartograph is complementary to code-execution approaches: it controls which tool descriptions are surfaced and records the provenance of the descriptions used for ranking for each query.
title: Cartograph: Federated Tool Discovery with Operator-Attested Retrieval for AI Agents
title_translated: Cartograph：基于操作员验证检索的联邦工具发现，用于AI代理
summary_translated: 模型上下文协议（MCP）使AI代理能够发现并调用工具，但随着连接目录的增长，加载每个工具定义的成本变得高昂。我们提出Cartograph，一种联邦MCP代理，将代理可见的工具发现从O(n)目录遍历转变为O(k)渐进式披露。Cartograph结合了三种机制：(1) 操作员验证的能力卡片，即在部署操作员控制下生成的Ed25519签名描述，而非由发布者排名的副本；(2) Rift，一种三层混淆聚类分析，包括密度聚类、查询边界分析和标记诊断；(3) 两阶段检索，先对服务器排序再对工具排序。在一个包含22个服务器、374个工具的部署中，Cartograph仅暴露3个代理工具，而非374个定义。一个由作者构建的49个查询基准测试显示，R@5达到0.816，而Jaccard关键词基线仅为0.592；同时，测量的前5名发现交换仅使用475个token，远低于全目录计账下的42,450个token。Rift识别出49个混淆聚类，其中包括四个在自动生成卡片中的高风险聚类。对119个LLM生成描述的探索性比较消除了观察到的零距离聚类，但表明混合卡片生成方式会降低R@5。在十次试验中，网关测量增加了5ms的平均延迟（0.8%），相对于直接stdio MCP调用。Cartograph与代码执行方法互补：它控制哪些工具描述被呈现，并记录每次查询用于排序的描述来源。

summary: Online reviews shape consumer decisions, platform governance, and corporate reputation.Fake reviews compromise this information channel by injecting deceptive evidence into rating systems, recommendation pipelines, and public trust mechanisms.The rise of large language models, or LLMs, has changed the problem in two directions.LLMs can generate fluent and context-aware deceptive reviews, while pre-trained language models, or PLMs, and LLMs also provide stronger semantic representations for detection.This survey reviews fake review detection from an information fusion perspective, covering 211 studies published from 2018 to early 2026.We organize existing work by evidence source and fusion level, covering review text, sentiment, rating behavior, temporal metadata, user-product graphs, multimodal content, external knowledge, and LLM-generated signals.We trace the development from traditional machine learning and deep learning to PLM-based and LLM-based methods, and examine how different approaches combine textual, behavioral, structural, and multimodal evidence.We also analyze reported performance trends on widely used Amazon, Yelp, and OpSpam benchmark families, while noting the limitations caused by different label construction procedures, data splits, and evaluation protocols.Finally, we identify open problems in adversarial generation, cross-domain transfer, uncertainty-aware fusion, missing-source robustness, interpretability, and trustworthy evaluation for AI-generated deceptive content.
title: A Survey on Fake Review Detection: From Pre-trained Language Models to Large Language Models

title_translated: 虚假评论检测综述：从预训练语言模型到大语言模型
summary_translated: 在线评论影响消费者决策、平台治理和企业声誉。虚假评论通过向评分系统、推荐流程和公众信任机制注入欺骗性证据，破坏这一信息渠道。大语言模型（LLMs）的兴起使该问题呈现两个方向的变化：LLMs能够生成流畅且情境感知的欺骗性评论，而预训练语言模型（PLMs）和LLMs也提供了更强的语义表示能力以支持检测。本综述从信息融合视角回顾虚假评论检测，涵盖2018年至2026年初发表的211项研究。我们按证据来源和融合层级组织现有工作，涵盖评论文本、情感、评分行为、时间元数据、用户-产品图、多模态内容、外部知识以及LLM生成信号。我们追溯了从传统机器学习和深度学习到基于PLM和LLM的方法的发展历程，并探讨不同方法如何整合文本、行为、结构和多模态证据。我们还分析了在广泛使用的Amazon、Yelp和OpSpam基准家族上的性能趋势，同时指出因标签构建方式、数据划分和评估协议差异带来的局限性。最后，我们指出了对抗性生成、跨领域迁移、不确定性感知融合、缺失源鲁棒性、可解释性以及可信评估AI生成欺骗内容等开放性问题。

summary: Production text-to-SQL pipelines often end with an LLM-as-judge whose agreement with human annotators has never actually been measured. When we checked ours, the deployed gpt-4o-mini judge agreed with two-author gold at only Cohen's kappa = 0.04 on a disagreement-enriched set and 0.42 on a uniform-random spot-check, over-flagging 77.1% of the human-FAITHFUL cases in the enriched set. Most of its over-flags trace back to a single mechanism we call GRADE-HALLUCINATION. A self-hosted Qwen3.6-27B replacement (kappa = 0.72) lands in the same range as Claude Opus 4.7 (kappa = 0.71); the head-to-head is underpowered at n = 96, but for the deployment decision that hardly matters, since Qwen costs roughly 1/300 as much per call. Ensembling does not help for free. Pairing the weak judge with a stronger one degrades agreement, whereas three strong judges under unanimity routing reach kappa = 0.79 at 89.7% auto-coverage. Applied out-of-domain, the same audit recipe flags 25.5% of BIRD-financial's expert-authored gold SQLs as candidate gold-SQL issues under our annotation protocol. Code and pre-registration are at https://github.com/JamesL404/synca-audit.
title: Auditing and Repairing LLM-as-Judge Failures in a Production Text-to-SQL Pipeline
title_translated: 在生产级文本到SQL管道中审计与修复LLM作为裁判的失败
summary_translated: 生产级文本到SQL管道通常以LLM作为裁判收尾，但其与人工标注者的一致性从未真正被测量。当我们检查自己的系统时，部署的gpt-4o-mini裁判在争议丰富集上与双人黄金标准的一致性仅为Cohen's kappa = 0.04，在均匀随机抽样检查中为0.42，且在丰富集中过度标记了77.1%的人工FAITHFUL案例。其大多数误报可归因于我们称之为GRADE-HALLUCINATION的单一机制。一个自托管的Qwen3.6-27B替代方案（kappa = 0.72）达到了与Claude Opus 4.7（kappa = 0.71）相当的水平；尽管头对头对比在n=96时统计功效不足，但对于部署决策而言几乎无关紧要，因为Qwen每次调用成本仅为后者的约1/300。集成无法免费提升效果。将弱裁判与强裁判配对反而降低了一致性，而三个强裁判采用一致路由时，kappa达到0.79，自动覆盖率达89.7%。应用于域外场景时，相同的审计方法在我们的标注协议下，将25.5%的BIRD-financial专家编写的黄金SQL标记为候选黄金SQL问题。代码与预注册信息见https://github.com/JamesL404/synca-audit。

summary: In team collaboration scenarios, memory is heterogeneous and continually evolving. Team memories capture collective decisions, protocols, and current consensus, while individual memories preserve member-specific observations, execution traces, and intermediate progress. Existing memory-augmented systems typically retrieve from all stored memories as a flat pool, ranking them by semantic relevance, importance, or recency without modeling hierarchical structure or evolving validity. As a result, they often surface semantically relevant but outdated or conflicting memories, especially individual memories that no longer align with current team consensus, instead of prioritizing currently valid memories. This is particularly problematic when collaborative LLM agents answer user questions, since their responses should be grounded in valid memories. We propose HiCoMER, a framework for hierarchical collaborative memory management and validity-aware retrieval in LLM agents. HiCoMER first maintains the validity of team and individual memories and then retrieves memories that remain valid, rather than retrieving directly from all stored memories. It consists of three components: a Hierarchical Memory Conflict Updater, a Validity-Aware Memory Retriever, and a Memory-Grounded Answer Generator. To evaluate HiCoMER, we construct two new datasets for memory-grounded question answering in collaborative settings. Experiments on both datasets show that HiCoMER consistently outperforms strong baselines by reducing outdated retrieval, preserving current team consensus, and improving downstream QA quality.
title: Not All Memories Are Equal: Hierarchical Collaborative Memory for Validity-Aware Retrieval in LLM Agents
title_translated: 并非所有记忆都同等重要：面向有效性的分层协作记忆用于LLM代理
summary_translated: 在团队协作场景中，记忆具有异质性且持续演化。团队记忆捕捉集体决策、规程和当前共识，而个体记忆则保存成员特定的观察、执行轨迹和中间进展。现有的记忆增强系统通常将所有存储记忆视为扁平池进行检索，仅根据语义相关性、重要性或新近性排序，而未建模层次结构或动态有效性。因此，它们常会暴露语义相关但过时或冲突的记忆，尤其是不再符合当前团队共识的个体记忆，而非优先选择当前有效的记忆。这在协作式LLM代理回答用户问题时尤为严重，因为其回答应基于有效记忆。我们提出HiCoMER框架，用于LLM代理中的分层协作记忆管理与有效性感知检索。HiCoMER首先维护团队与个体记忆的有效性，然后检索仍有效的记忆，而非直接从所有存储记忆中检索。该框架包含三个组件：分层记忆冲突更新器、有效性感知记忆检索器和记忆基础答案生成器。为评估HiCoMER，我们构建了两个新的数据集，用于协作场景下的记忆基础问答任务。在两个数据集上的实验表明，HiCoMER始终优于强基线，减少了过时检索，保留了当前团队共识，并提升了下游问答质量。

summary: In Transformer-based masked language models, attention is the primary mechanism for context mixing, but there are other ways to mix data across tokens. Recent attention-free mixers replace attention with fixed or hypernetwork-generated MLPs, alternating their dynamic, content-dependent weighting for computational simplicity. We build an alternative that gets the same property from a low-rank bottleneck autoencoder. We replace attention with a stack of autoencoder-based mixing modules, one operating over local neighborhoods, one over the full sequence, and one across attention heads, each compressing and reconstructing its input through a bottleneck, and its width is a hyperparameter rather than a training effect. In masked positions, we introduce an iterative refinement procedure that has two distinct steps. A pulling step that pulls an embedding representation toward a weighted average of its neighbors, and a correcting step that projects the result back to the learned manifold via an autoencoder. Our architecture achieves a significant portion of attention's performance at about $1.9 \times$ fewer FLOPs when pretrained on C4 and evaluated with parameter-matched BERT baselines. Our model equals parameter-matched BERT and TinyBERT baselines on the rarest-token frequency bucket using a frequency-aware training schedule that samples rare tokens more than uniformly for the masking tasks.
title: Manifold Projection and Iterative Autoencoder Refinement for Masked Language Modeling

title_translated: 流形投影与迭代自编码器精炼用于掩码语言建模
summary_translated: 在基于Transformer的掩码语言模型中，注意力是上下文混合的主要机制，但还有其他方式可在词元间混合数据。近期无注意力混合器用固定或超网络生成的MLP替代注意力，通过交替其动态、内容依赖的权重以简化计算。我们提出一种替代方案，通过低秩瓶颈自编码器实现相同特性。我们将注意力替换为一系列基于自编码器的混合模块，分别作用于局部邻域、整个序列以及注意力头之间，每个模块通过瓶颈压缩并重构输入，其宽度为超参数而非训练结果。在掩码位置，我们引入一种迭代精炼过程，包含两个独立步骤：拉取步骤将嵌入表示拉向其邻居的加权平均值，校正步骤则通过自编码器将结果投影回学习到的流形。在C4数据集上预训练并使用参数匹配的BERT基线进行评估时，该架构在约1.9倍更少的FLOPs下实现了注意力性能的显著部分。在采用频率感知训练策略（对稀有词元采样频率高于均匀分布）的情况下，该模型在最罕见词元频率桶上与参数匹配的BERT和TinyBERT基线表现相当。

summary: AI-generated text detectors achieve high accuracy on standard benchmarks, yet the internal representations that drive these predictions remain poorly understood. We study which neurons in a frozen BERT-base-uncased encoder support AI-text detection, using the RAID benchmark across six generators spanning pure-base and instruction-tuned models. We apply the L1-to-L2 sparse-probing protocol of Gurnee et al. (2023) to all 9,216 CLS hidden-state dimensions (12 layers x 768), which we call neurons. The procedure recovers a stable set of under 1% of neurons per generator, consistent across folds and seeds; a probe restricted to that set retains most of the full-feature detection accuracy. Bidirectional activation patching confirms this set's causal relevance: in both directions it flips predictions an order of magnitude more often than size-matched random sets. Mean-ablating the same neurons leaves accuracy largely intact; the signal is therefore redundantly distributed. Cross-generator analysis reveals a bipartite structure: instruction-tuned generators concentrate 30-36% of stable neurons in BERT's final layer while both base generators fall below 14%, consistent with a layer-12 footprint of post-training alignment. Leave-one-family-out evaluation shows the selected neurons retain 86-94% of the full-feature ceiling on unseen generator families, so a detector can operate on a small fixed subspace without re-identifying neurons per generator.
title: A Mechanistic Study of AI-Text Detection Neurons in Frozen BERT: Sparse Probing and Activation Patching on RAID

title_translated: 冻结BERT中AI文本检测神经元的机制研究：基于RAID的稀疏探测与激活修补
summary_translated: AI生成文本检测器在标准基准测试上表现出高准确率，但驱动这些预测的内部表征仍不清晰。我们研究了冻结的BERT-base-uncased编码器中哪些神经元支持AI文本检测，使用涵盖纯基础模型和指令微调模型的六种生成器在RAID基准上进行分析。对全部9,216个CLS隐藏状态维度（12层×768）应用Gurnee等人（2023）提出的L1到L2稀疏探测协议，我们将这些维度称为神经元。该方法在每种生成器中恢复出少于1%的稳定神经元集合，且在不同折叠和随机种子间保持一致；仅使用该子集的探测器仍能保留大部分全特征检测准确率。双向激活修补证实了该集合的因果相关性：在两个方向上，其预测翻转频率比大小匹配的随机集合高出一个数量级。对相同神经元进行均值消融后，准确率基本不变；表明信号具有冗余分布特性。跨生成器分析揭示出双分结构：指令微调生成器将30-36%的稳定神经元集中在BERT的最后一层，而基础生成器则低于14%，这与训练后对齐的第12层特征足迹一致。留一家族评估显示，所选神经元在未见生成器家族上仍保持86-94%的全特征上限性能，因此检测器可在固定小子空间上运行，无需为每种生成器重新识别神经元。

summary: Reasoning models often generate very long reasoning traces, making inference computationally expensive. Existing approaches typically improve efficiency either through inference-time early-stopping mechanisms or by explicitly encouraging shorter reasoning during training, for example through reinforcement learning with length penalties. We show that substantial efficiency gains can instead emerge from a different kind of supervision: \textit{confidence}. Using a self-supervised procedure, we fine-tune reasoning models to predict their confidence in the answer at intermediate points along their own reasoning trajectories using only 600 training problems. Confidence is used only as a training target: the loss contains no objective for reasoning length, efficiency, or stopping. At inference, the fine-tuned models use the standard generation procedure, with no confidence elicitation or early-stopping mechanism. Despite this, self-supervised confidence fine-tuning makes reasoning more efficient, reducing generated tokens by up to 25\% at matched accuracy across Gemma, Qwen, Nemotron, and GPT-OSS models on mathematical, scientific, and coding reasoning benchmarks, with efficiency gains comparable to methods that explicitly optimize for shorter reasoning. Analysis of reasoning episodes further shows that confidence supervision largely preserves the base models' high-level reasoning composition rather than selectively suppressing particular behaviors. Our results suggest that efficient reasoning may emerge as a downstream consequence of learning metacognitive signals, without being directly optimized.
title: Learning to Stop without Learning to Stop: Self-Supervised Confidence Training Improves Reasoning Efficiency
title_translated: 无需学习停止：自监督置信度训练提升推理效率
summary_translated: 推理模型常生成过长的推理轨迹，导致推理计算成本高昂。现有方法通常通过推理时的早期停止机制或在训练中显式鼓励更短推理（如使用长度惩罚的强化学习）来提升效率。我们发现，另一种监督方式——置信度——也能带来显著效率提升。通过自监督过程，我们仅用600个训练问题微调推理模型，使其在自身推理轨迹的中间点预测对答案的置信度。置信度仅作为训练目标：损失函数中不含推理长度、效率或停止的任何目标。在推理阶段，微调后的模型使用标准生成流程，不涉及置信度提取或早期停止机制。尽管如此，自监督置信度微调使推理更高效，在Gemma、Qwen、Nemotron和GPT-OSS模型上，数学、科学和编程推理基准测试中生成token数减少高达25%，且准确率保持一致，效率提升与显式优化短推理的方法相当。对推理过程的进一步分析表明，置信度监督主要保留了基线模型的高层次推理结构，而非选择性抑制特定行为。结果表明，高效推理可能作为学习元认知信号的下游结果自然涌现，而无需直接优化。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) implicitly infer attributes of their users and adapt their behavior accordingly, yet these beliefs remain difficult to inspect and causally manipulate. We introduce Belief Self-Distillation (BSD), a unified read-write framework that bridges linear and causal probing by learning a compact user representation that can be both decoded and written back into the model. The frozen LLM acts as its own teacher, distilling beliefs from natural conversations without external annotations. Unlike conventional probing, BSD isolates not only information present in activations, but a state whose causal role can be directly tested. Across multiple model families, BSD faithfully recovers user beliefs and enables substantially stronger interventions than matched hidden-state steering. Crucially, we find that refusal depends not only on the request, but on the model's inferred user intent: changing this belief alters refusal while holding the request fixed. We further uncover a striking cross-model regularity: independently trained LLMs converge on a shared geometry for representing their users. Together, these results reveal implicit user models as readable and causally writable internal states with direct implications for AI safety, shaping how models condition safety decisions on whom they believe they are interacting with.
title: User Model Extraction via Belief Self-Distillation
title_translated: 通过信念自蒸馏实现用户模型提取
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）会隐式推断用户属性并相应调整行为，但这些信念难以观察和因果操控。我们提出信念自蒸馏（BSD），一种统一的读写框架，通过学习紧凑的用户表示，桥接线性探针与因果探针，该表示既可解码也可写回模型。冻结的LLM充当自身教师，从自然对话中蒸馏信念，无需外部标注。不同于传统探针，BSD不仅捕捉激活中的信息，还捕获可直接测试因果作用的状态。在多个模型家族中，BSD能忠实还原用户信念，并实现比匹配的隐藏状态操控更强的干预效果。关键发现是：拒绝行为不仅取决于请求内容，还取决于模型推断的用户意图；改变这一信念可影响拒绝行为，同时保持请求不变。我们还发现一个显著的跨模型规律：独立训练的LLMs在表示用户方面趋于收敛于共享的几何结构。这些结果揭示了隐式用户模型是可读取且可因果写入的内部状态，对AI安全具有直接意义，决定了模型如何根据其相信的交互对象来做出安全决策。

summary: We investigate whether natural-language documentation helps coding agents resolve software issues, and we build the tools to construct and evaluate it. We introduce a roundtrip benchmark that scores code descriptions by whether code regenerated from them passes the original tests, and show that completeness, not length, drives a description's fidelity. Using the benchmark as an optimization signal, we discover a description-writing prompt that reaches full fidelity and generalizes to unseen files. We then test the hypothesis that motivated the work: that better documentation helps an agent resolve real repository issues. Across two model families and ten repositories, and against a positive control confirming that our evaluation can detect a genuine improvement, we find that it does not. When the source is present, neither static compact documentation nor retrieved context beats the issue alone. We report this negative result together with the benchmark and the optimizer, and we characterize the boundary at which documentation helps.
title: Compact Documentation for Coding Agents: A Benchmark, an Optimizer, and Why It Does Not Transfer

title_translated: 代码智能体的紧凑文档：一个基准、一个优化器及其不具泛化性
summary_translated: 我们探究自然语言文档是否有助于代码智能体解决软件问题，并构建了用于构建和评估文档的工具。我们引入了一个往返基准，通过检查从文档再生的代码是否通过原始测试来评分，结果表明，完整性而非长度是决定文档保真度的关键因素。利用该基准作为优化信号，我们发现一种描述写作提示，能够达到完整保真度并泛化至未见过的文件。随后我们检验了本研究的核心假设：更好的文档是否有助于智能体解决真实仓库问题。在两种模型家族和十个仓库中，对比一个正向对照以确认我们的评估能检测真实改进，我们发现并未产生效果。当源代码存在时，无论是紧凑静态文档还是检索上下文，均无法超越仅使用问题本身的表现。我们报告了这一负面结果，同时提供基准和优化器，并刻画了文档起效的边界条件。

summary: We study false-alert control when screening for text generated by artificial intelligence (AI). The screening procedure selects document prefixes and detectors from observed evidence and may stop before exhausting its inspection budget. We give two finite-sample constructions under document-level exchangeability between human calibration documents and a new null document, with no restriction on dependence among tokens within a document. Construction A registers a finite family of prefix-detector scores and allocates a false-alert budget across their conformal ranks. A union bound protects any executed subset of that family. Construction B calibrates the complete-path maximum of a development-fixed adaptive policy. Each partial-path maximum is bounded by the complete maximum, so a terminal conformal rank protects early stopping without splitting the error budget. We prove marginal control of any false alert across the permitted inspection path and derive necessary calibration counts for rejection. We also state oracle testing, distribution-shift, and independent-audit bounds with their additional assumptions. Both constructions protect stopping within their specified scope; neither proof constructs an e-process or justifies multiplying conformal ranks. Detection power and computational savings remain questions for empirical evaluation.
title: Two Conformal Constructions for Adaptive Within-Document AI-Text Screening

title_translated: 自适应文档内AI文本筛查的两种共形构造
summary_translated: 我们研究在筛查人工智能生成文本时如何控制误报。筛查过程根据观测证据选择文档前缀和检测器，可能在耗尽检查预算前停止。我们在文档层面交换性（即人类校准文档与新空文档之间）的前提下，提出了两种有限样本构造方法，且不限制文档内标记之间的依赖关系。构造A注册一组前缀-检测器得分，并在其共形秩上分配误报预算。联合界保护该族中任意执行的子集。构造B校准开发固定自适应策略的完整路径最大值。每个部分路径最大值被完整最大值所限制，因此终端共形秩可在不拆分误差预算的情况下保护提前停止。我们证明了在允许的检查路径上任意误报的边际控制，并推导出拒绝所需的校准次数。我们还给出了Oracle测试、分布偏移和独立审计的边界及其附加假设。两种构造均在指定范围内保护停止行为；但两者证明均未构造e-process，也未证明共形秩相乘的合理性。检测能力与计算节省仍需通过实证评估验证。

summary: We develop a statistically explicit sentiment index for Google Play user reviews and establish the mathematical results supporting its construction. Normalized star ratings and text-sentiment scores are treated as noisy measures of latent review valence and fused by covariance-aware inverse-variance weighting. Review-level estimates are aggregated with bounded helpfulness and recency weights, then shrunk toward a population mean using estimated precision rather than an arbitrary review-count threshold. App-level rating histograms provide a distributional diagnostic for samples returned under different API sort orders; because star ratings are discrete, classical continuous Kolmogorov-Smirnov critical values are not used. A local-level state-space model and the Kalman filter provide a denoised temporal trend. Full proofs cover the BLUE and Gaussian maximum-likelihood result, Gaussian-conjugate shrinkage, the Glivenko-Cantelli and Donsker theorems, count transformations via the delta method, and exact Gaussian Kalman filtering. A worked three-review example shows how textual complaints can materially reduce an apparently perfect star-only score.
title: Statistical Foundations for a Google Play User-Review Sentiment Index: Signal Fusion, Shrinkage, Distributional Validation, and Dynamic Smoothing

title_translated: 谷歌应用商店用户评论情感指数的统计基础：信号融合、收缩估计、分布验证与动态平滑
summary_translated: 我们构建了一个针对谷歌应用商店用户评论的统计明确的情感指数，并建立了支持其构建的数学理论。将归一化的星级评分和文本情感得分视为潜在评论价值的噪声测量值，通过考虑协方差的逆方差加权进行融合。在评论级别估计后，使用有界帮助度和新近度权重聚合，并基于估计精度而非任意评论数量阈值向总体均值收缩。应用级别的评分直方图为不同API排序方式返回的样本提供了分布诊断；由于星级评分是离散的，不采用经典的连续柯尔莫哥洛夫-斯米尔诺夫临界值。局部层次的状态空间模型与卡尔曼滤波器提供去噪的时间趋势。完整证明涵盖了BLUE和高斯最大似然结果、高斯共轭收缩、Glivenko-Cantelli与Donsker定理、通过delta方法的计数变换以及精确的高斯卡尔曼滤波。一个包含三条评论的实例展示了文本投诉如何显著降低看似完美的仅基于星级的评分。

summary: LLMs increasingly act as purchasing agents, which makes the LLM, not the user, the one choosing among the options that satisfy a request; its preferences quietly fix what gets bought and what it costs. Hotel booking is a clean instance: a high-volume choice settled on a few comparable attributes, where the pick reveals those preferences. We introduce PriceBench, a diagnostic benchmark that recovers an LLM's price, quality, and brand preferences from its booking choices with a logit choice model, applied to 28 LLMs from 8 providers on 3,600 hotel tasks from 179 real New York City properties. We find that capability is associated with how consistently an LLM chooses, not with what it chooses: more capable LLMs hold stronger, more consistent preferences, while weaker ones either lock onto one position, exploitable by whoever controls listing order, or choose almost indifferently. What those preferences favor varies sharply across providers and even within one family: price sensitivity spans more than an order of magnitude, and the price/quality trade-off moves mean booked nightly price from \$247 to \$393 on identical tasks. What an agent buys must therefore be measured per LLM, not inferred, and we release the tasks, code, and all 28 response sets.
title: PriceBench: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Price, Quality, and Brand Preferences in LLM Booking Agents

title_translated: PriceBench：用于大语言模型预订代理中价格、质量与品牌偏好的诊断基准
summary_translated: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地充当购买代理，使得模型本身成为选择满足请求选项的主体，其偏好悄然决定了购买内容及其成本。酒店预订是一个清晰的实例：高频率的选择集中在少数可比属性上，选择结果揭示了这些偏好。我们提出了PriceBench，一种诊断基准，通过逻辑选择模型从LLM的预订选择中恢复其对价格、质量和品牌的偏好，应用于来自8家供应商的28个LLM，在3,600个来自179个真实纽约市房产的酒店任务上进行测试。研究发现，能力与LLM选择的一致性相关，而非选择的内容本身：更强大的LLM表现出更强且更一致的偏好，而较弱的LLM则要么锁定某一位置（易被列表顺序控制者利用），要么几乎无差别选择。这些偏好所倾向的内容在不同供应商之间甚至同一家族内部差异显著：价格敏感度跨度超过一个数量级，相同任务下的价格/质量权衡使预订每晚价格从247美元上升至393美元。因此，必须针对每个LLM单独测量其购买行为，而非推断。我们公开了所有任务、代码和28个响应集。

summary: Large language model-based multi-agent debate (MAD) systems are being increasingly used as complex decision pipelines in distributed processes. However, their final synthesis phase still remains inadequately controlled. Even with detailed debate logs, summarizing models are prone to fabricating smoothly written debate consensus that is not grounded in the debate's history. To address this safety gap, this paper presents empirical research and studies if the introduction of active post-debate verification can mitigate the production of such factually unsupported summaries, while still providing valuable information. Furthermore, it is examined whether explicitly signalling divergence is preferable in the absence of a reliable compromise. The Active Provenance Gate (APG) is introduced as a post-debate verification layer that treats the source as a hard constraint, analysing the debate logs, auditing each claim, and applying self-correction. In crisis simulations, the self-healing mechanism more than doubles the average data Provenance Fidelity in difficult condition scenarios, before the strict gate blocks unsupported claims and generates divergence reports. In the human study, a vast majority of the users (over 75%) preferred a report explicitly stating failure in critical scenarios, despite most of them perceiving fabricated consensus from the baseline system as more fluent. Our main contribution is the transition of data origin tracing from passive logging to active conditional blocking before publication.
title: Towards Mitigating Fabricated Consensus: The Active Provenance Gate for Multi-Agent Debate Synthesis

title_translated: 缓解虚构共识：面向多智能体辩论合成的主动溯源门机制
summary_translated: 基于大语言模型的多智能体辩论（MAD）系统正被越来越多地用作分布式流程中的复杂决策管道。然而，其最终合成阶段仍缺乏有效控制。即使拥有详细的辩论日志，摘要模型仍容易生成看似流畅但未基于辩论历史的事实性虚假共识。为解决这一安全漏洞，本文通过实证研究探讨引入事后主动验证是否能缓解此类无事实依据摘要的生成，同时仍提供有价值的信息。此外，还考察了在缺乏可靠妥协的情况下，显式标记分歧是否更优。本文提出“主动溯源门”（APG）作为事后验证层，将来源视为硬约束，分析辩论日志，审计每一项主张并执行自我修正。在危机模拟中，自愈机制使困难情境下的平均数据溯源保真度提升超过一倍；在严格门控阻止无支持主张并生成分歧报告前，系统表现优异。在人类实验中，绝大多数用户（超过75%）更倾向于在关键场景中明确报告失败，尽管他们普遍认为基线系统生成的虚构共识更具流畅性。本文主要贡献在于将数据来源追踪从被动日志记录转变为发布前的主动条件阻断。

summary: Automated and highly usable Quality-of-Service (QoS) enforcement requires translating high-level service intents into deployable traffic-management policies. Although intent-based networking (IBN) has simplified policy specification, bridging the gap between business-level intents and executable network configurations remains complex, error-prone, and difficult to automate. This paper presents Intent2Tc, a closed-loop language-model-driven framework that translates business-level traffic-shaping intents into declarative sub-intents and subsequently into validated, executable Linux traffic control (tc) configurations. The framework integrates an Active Queue Management (AQM)-based digital twin (DT) semantic model, automated metadata extraction, critique-driven refinement, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)-based knowledge reuse to improve semantic consistency and configuration reliability. We evaluate multiple open-source large language models (LLMs) and small language models (SLMs), together with Claude Sonnet-4.6, on 100 Request for Comments (RFC) 9315-compliant traffic-shaping intents. Across both translation stages, Intent2Tc achieves high semantic fidelity, configuration accuracy, and deployment readiness, with Claude Sonnet-4.6 reaching 0.98 semantic similarity, 1.0 semantic unit coverage, and 0.045 normalized edit distance. Furthermore, RAG reduces token consumption and inference latency while enabling compact models such as Phi-4-mini to approach the performance of substantially larger models. Linux tc serves as the target configuration platform, demonstrating the practical applicability of the proposed framework.
title: Intent2Tc: Automated Intent-to-Traffic Control Translation with Language Models

title_translated: Intent2Tc：基于语言模型的意图到流量控制指令自动化翻译
summary_translated: 实现自动化且高度可用的服务质量（QoS）强制需要将高层次服务意图转化为可部署的流量管理策略。尽管基于意图的网络（IBN）简化了策略定义，但在业务意图与可执行网络配置之间架桥仍存在复杂性、易出错且难以自动化的问题。本文提出Intent2Tc，一个闭环的语言模型驱动框架，将业务级流量整形意图转化为声明式子意图，进而生成经验证的、可执行的Linux流量控制（tc）配置。该框架整合了基于主动队列管理（AQM）的数字孪生（DT）语义模型、自动元数据提取、批判驱动的优化以及基于检索增强生成（RAG）的知识复用，以提升语义一致性与配置可靠性。我们在100个符合RFC 9315标准的流量整形意图上评估多个开源大语言模型（LLMs）和小语言模型（SLMs），以及Claude Sonnet-4.6。在两个翻译阶段中，Intent2Tc均实现了高语义保真度、配置准确性和部署就绪性，其中Claude Sonnet-4.6达到0.98的语义相似度、1.0的语义单元覆盖率和0.045的归一化编辑距离。此外，RAG降低了令牌消耗和推理延迟，使如Phi-4-mini等紧凑模型接近远大于其规模模型的性能。Linux tc作为目标配置平台，证明了该框架的实际适用性。

summary: Whether an information extraction pipeline should process page images or parsed text depends on the document, and the answer flips across the layout spectrum. We study this trade-off under a constraint that rules out (closed) cloud services: privacy-sensitive documents processed on-premise by small ($\le 8\mathrm{B}$ parameter) text-only and vision--language models, evaluated on both accuracy and energy over a design space spanning input representation, model family, and inference configuration. Benchmarking on the near-plain-text Kleister-NDA contracts and the layout-rich VRDU forms, we find that batching is the dominant energy lever, cutting energy per page by 38-85% at no cost in accuracy, while FP8 quantization saves 27-32% when requests are served one at a time but less than 1mWh per page (9-19%) once batching is applied. Preprocessing dominates what remains: neural OCR costs $17\times$ more energy per page than classical OCR and never reaches the Pareto frontier. Which representation wins flips with the type of document: vision--language models on layout-rich documents and small text-only models with a cheap parser on near-plain text, where they are both more accurate and cheaper than any vision--language configuration. Our work yields concrete guidelines for energy-efficient, privacy-compliant local information extraction.
title: The Right Information Extraction Pipeline Depends on the Document: Accuracy-Energy Trade-offs for Small, Local Models

title_translated: 正确的信息抽取流程取决于文档类型：小型本地模型的准确性-能耗权衡
summary_translated: 信息抽取流程应处理页面图像还是解析文本，取决于文档类型，且在布局谱系上的答案会发生反转。我们在排除（封闭）云服务的前提下研究这一权衡：隐私敏感文档由小型（≤8B参数）纯文本模型和视觉-语言模型在本地处理，评估其在准确性与能耗方面的表现，覆盖输入表示、模型族和推理配置的设计空间。在近似纯文本的Kleister-NDA合同与布局丰富的VRDU表格上进行基准测试，发现批处理是主要的能耗杠杆，可在不影响准确性的前提下将每页能耗降低38%-85%；FP8量化在单次请求时节省27%-32%能耗，但一旦启用批处理，每页节省不足1mWh（9%-19%）。预处理主导剩余部分：神经OCR每页能耗是传统OCR的17倍，且从未达到帕累托前沿。哪种表示方式占优随文档类型而变：在布局丰富的文档上，视觉-语言模型表现更优；而在近似纯文本文档上，搭配廉价解析器的小型纯文本模型在准确性和成本上均优于任何视觉-语言配置。本工作为节能、符合隐私要求的本地信息抽取提供了具体指导。

summary: Speech-based screening is a promising, non-invasive approach for detecting Alzheimer's disease and related cognitive risks. However, models trained on a single domain often generalize poorly to unseen languages, tasks, or recording protocols. This paper investigates this deployment gap using a leave-one-corpus-out evaluation across four distinct datasets. Among 70 interpretable speech and language features, 59 exhibit direction conflicts between healthy control and cognitive risk groups across corpora, with pause, silence, and speech rate showing high protocol sensitivity. Furthermore, while the XLM-R text baseline achieves strong average performance, its Area Under the ROC Curve (AUC) drops to 0.520 on the weakest held-out domain. A standard GroupDRO baseline reaches a 0.766 mean speaker AUC and a 0.504 worst-domain AUC under the same protocol. To address this, we propose a fusion method that integrates XLM-R text baseline scores with evidence anchors selected during training. Balanced fusion achieves a 0.785 mean speaker AUC, while anchor-heavy fusion raises the worst-case speaker AUC to 0.615. This work highlights the need to audit feature transferability and report worst-case domain robustness in cognitive speech screening.
title: Why Alzheimer's Speech Screening Fails to Generalize: Bridging the Deployment Gap via Cross-Corpus Evidence Anchoring

title_translated: 阿尔茨海默病语音筛查为何无法泛化：通过跨语料库证据锚定弥合部署差距
summary_translated: 基于语音的筛查是一种有前景的无创方法，可用于检测阿尔茨海默病及相关认知风险。然而，仅在单一领域训练的模型往往难以泛化到未见过的语言、任务或录音协议。本文通过在四个不同数据集上采用留一语料库评估的方法研究了这一部署差距。在70个可解释的语音和语言特征中，有59个在健康对照组与认知风险组之间表现出方向冲突，其中停顿、静音和语音速率显示出较高的协议敏感性。尽管XLM-R文本基线在平均性能上表现良好，但在最弱的保留领域其ROC曲线下面积（AUC）下降至0.520。标准GroupDRO基线在同一协议下达到0.766的平均说话人AUC和0.504的最差领域AUC。为解决此问题，我们提出一种融合方法，将XLM-R文本基线得分与训练期间选定的证据锚点结合。平衡融合实现0.785的平均说话人AUC，而锚点主导融合则将最坏情况下的说话人AUC提升至0.615。本工作强调了审计特征可迁移性以及报告最差领域鲁棒性的必要性。

summary: Models trained with reinforcement learning for calibrated decisions (RLCD), such as Jev, answer a typed question about an input, the state, with a probability, a choice, or a score, and software acts on the answer without a person reading it. Their robustness has not been measured: adversarial benchmarks score what a model generates or executes, whereas a typed model generates nothing and returns a well-formed answer even when manipulated. Measurement is also hard, because identical requests can return different answers, most available labels come from the model itself, and the API preprocesses each request out of view. Our key idea is to score each attacked decision against the model's own clean decision rather than against labels, and to read it against the change caused by an identical re-run. Building on this, we introduce JevAdvBench, to our knowledge the first adversarial benchmark for RLCD models, with 812 typed questions over 66 scenarios, and a black-box attack suite of 9,744 single-edit variants that each edit one part of a request, with billed input tokens confirming that the edit reached the model. On jev-1.13.0, rewording stays within 1.2 percentage points of the re-run baseline, and fields outside the schema never reach the model. In contrast, one unverified opinion appended to the state flips 12.1% of decisions, statistically tied with the strongest injected command (10.1%), and pushes 38% of confident answers below the 0.8 confidence threshold that routes them to human review. Applications built on RLCD models should therefore treat the state as untrusted, argued input. Project website: https://JevAdvBench.github.io/JevAdvBench/
title: JevAdvBench: A Benchmark and Black-Box Attacks for Reinforcement Learning for Calibrated Decisions Models

title_translated: JevAdvBench：用于校准决策强化学习模型的基准测试与黑盒攻击
summary_translated: 使用强化学习进行校准决策（RLCD）训练的模型（如Jev）会针对输入状态回答类型化问题，输出概率、选择或评分，软件根据答案自动执行操作而无需人工阅读。然而，这类模型的鲁棒性尚未得到测量：对抗性基准通常衡量模型生成或执行的内容，但类型化模型本身不生成内容，即使被操纵也能返回格式正确的答案。测量也十分困难，因为相同请求可能产生不同答案，大多数可用标签来自模型自身，且API在不可见的情况下预处理每个请求。我们的核心思想是将每次攻击后的决策评分与模型自身的干净决策对比，而非与标签对比，并通过相同重运行带来的变化来评估。基于此，我们提出了JevAdvBench，据我们所知首个针对RLCD模型的对抗性基准，包含66种场景下的812个类型化问题，以及一个包含9,744个单编辑变体的黑盒攻击套件，每个变体仅修改请求的一部分，通过计费输入token确认修改已到达模型。在jev-1.13.0上，重述保持在重运行基线的1.2个百分点内，而超出模式字段的内容从未到达模型。相比之下，附加一个未经验证的意见会使12.1%的决策发生改变，统计上与最强注入命令（10.1%）相当，并使38%的高置信度答案降至0.8以下的置信阈值，触发人工审核。因此，基于RLCD模型构建的应用应将状态视为不可信的输入。

summary: Conversational agents, generative recommenders, and personalized advertising all rest on one capability: understanding each user from raw behavior. Prevailing industrial practice is task-specific: for each task, a relevant subsequence is extracted from the full history and a dedicated model trained on it. In production it hits two bottlenecks. First, even after filtering, a single-task sequence stays extremely long: content-interest summarization reads several hundred items per user, tens of thousands of tokens once serialized as prompt text. Second, profiles are refreshed routinely: a billion users weekly, roughly 100K QPM in aggregate, which under a fixed GPU budget sets a hard throughput floor. Compression is therefore mandatory, yet truncation or coarse compression can silently distort the profile, introducing four hallucination types (fabrication, omission, date misattribution, broken logic) that, with no way to evaluate the compressed representation itself, surface only as diffuse degradation in downstream metrics. We present KuaFu, a unified behavior-compression layer whose minimal unit is one behavior item. A two-axis projector compresses each item into 2-4 tokens of width 128-256 (about 10x along the token axis, 20x along width; per-item cache 10 KB to 0.5 KB), with fidelity-oriented four-stage training and layered intermediate evaluation. Across four production profiling tasks it matches or exceeds uncompressed single-task production models on all five headline metrics, raises per-GPU throughput by 37%-350%, and saves 190 GPUs. On public benchmarks it nearly always beats prior compressors at the same compression ratio (up to +17.7 EM on out-of-domain MRQA); on RecBench, a 4B model surpasses its 8B counterpart by 1.90 points. KuaFu has run on the Tencent advertising and recommendation platform for ten months, lifting overall GMV by 1.37%.
title: KuaFu: Compressing Long User Behavior into Understanding at Billion Scale

title_translated: KuaFu：在百亿规模下压缩长用户行为以实现理解
summary_translated: 对话式智能体、生成式推荐系统和个性化广告均依赖于从原始用户行为中理解每个用户的能力。当前工业实践为任务特定型：针对每个任务，从完整历史中提取相关子序列并训练专用模型。但在生产环境中，这面临两个瓶颈。首先，即使经过过滤，单任务序列仍极为冗长：内容兴趣摘要每用户需读取数百项，序列化为提示文本后达数万token。其次，用户画像需定期刷新：每百万用户每周更新，总计约10万QPM，在固定GPU预算下形成硬性吞吐下限。因此压缩成为必需，但截断或粗粒度压缩可能无声地扭曲画像，引入四种幻觉类型（虚构、遗漏、时间错位、逻辑断裂），由于无法直接评估压缩表示本身，这些错误仅表现为下游指标的广泛退化。我们提出KuaFu，一种统一的行为压缩层，其最小单位为单个行为项。双轴投影器将每项压缩为2-4个宽度128-256的token（沿token轴约10倍、沿宽度轴约20倍压缩；每项缓存从10KB降至0.5KB），采用面向保真度的四阶段训练和分层中间评估。在四项生产级画像任务中，KuaFu在所有五个核心指标上匹配或超越未压缩的单任务生产模型，每GPU吞吐量提升37%-350%，节省190台GPU。在公开基准测试中，几乎始终在相同压缩比下优于先前压缩器（在域外MRQA上最高提升17.7 EM）；在RecBench上，4B模型甚至超过其8B对应模型1.90分。KuaFu已在腾讯广告与推荐平台上线十个月，整体GMV提升1.37%。

summary: Researchers increasingly use generative large language models (LLMs) to convert corporate text into empirical variables. We examine the extent to which LLM-based textual measures are invariant to model choice using thirteen measures, including sentiment, management clarity, uncertainty, answer specificity, and climate and political risk. Seven LLMs from different providers score earnings call transcripts of S&P 500 companies on these constructs. Cross-model rank correlations average only 0.52, and transcript-level differences common across providers account for only 34% of total score variation. Cross-model disagreement does not predict subsequent analyst or market disagreement, consistent with a substantial model-specific component rather than common ambiguity in the underlying disclosure. Model choice significantly affects downstream inference, with coefficient magnitudes, signs, and statistical significance varying substantially across models. Averaging across providers makes transcript rankings more stable for most constructs, but score levels remain sensitive to the models included in the ensemble. LLM-generated variables should therefore be treated as model-contingent measurements and validated across providers.
title: Same Text, Different Numbers: The Divergence of LLM-Based Measures

title_translated: 同一文本，不同数值：基于大语言模型的度量差异
summary_translated: 研究人员越来越多地使用生成式大语言模型（LLMs）将企业文本转化为实证变量。我们考察了基于LLM的文本度量在模型选择上的不变性程度，共涉及十三种度量，包括情感、管理清晰度、不确定性、回答具体性以及气候与政治风险等。来自七个不同提供商的LLMs对标准普尔500公司财报电话会议记录进行了评分。跨模型排名相关性平均仅为0.52，且各提供商普遍存在的转录级差异仅解释了总评分变异的34%。跨模型分歧并不能预测后续分析师或市场分歧，表明存在显著的模型特异性成分，而非披露内容本身的共同模糊性。模型选择显著影响下游推断，系数大小、符号和统计显著性在不同模型间差异明显。对多个提供商结果取平均虽使转录排名更稳定，但评分水平仍对集成中包含的模型敏感。因此，LLM生成的变量应被视为依赖于模型的测量，并在多个提供商间进行验证。

summary: Uniform discrete diffusion models (UDMs) commonly use explicit time conditioning, but we find that it can often be unnecessary in practice. In this paper, we first show that the population-optimal UDM predictor generally depends on time: time controls how much the model should trust the observed context. We then show that this dependence can become negligible in finite-data settings relevant to language. When a corrupted training sequence remains much closer to its original clean sequence than to competing training sequences, the empirical-optimal predictor is nearly insensitive to time over most of the diffusion trajectory, where the guarantee weakens toward the high-noise endpoint. Empirically, trained language UDMs exhibit limited time sensitivity over most of the trajectory, while time-agnostic predictors remain competitive with, and often outperform, time-conditioned models across datasets and training objectives. These results challenge the use of explicit time conditioning in UDMs: although the population optimum depends on time, explicitly conditioning on it may often be unnecessary in practice.
title: Does Uniform Discrete Diffusion Need Time?

title_translated: 均匀离散扩散模型是否需要时间？
summary_translated: 均匀离散扩散模型（UDMs）通常使用显式时间条件，但我们发现这在实践中常常并非必要。本文首先表明，总体最优的UDM预测器通常依赖于时间：时间控制模型应多大程度信任观测上下文。随后我们证明，在与语言相关的有限数据设置中，这种依赖性可能变得微不足道。当受损训练序列与其原始清洁序列相比，远比与其他竞争训练序列更接近时，经验最优预测器在整个扩散轨迹的大部分阶段对时间几乎不敏感，仅在高噪声终点处保证减弱。实证上，训练好的语言UDM在轨迹大部分阶段表现出有限的时间敏感性，而无时间依赖的预测器在各类数据集和训练目标上仍能与时间条件模型相媲美，甚至表现更优。这些结果挑战了在UDM中使用显式时间条件的做法：尽管总体最优解依赖于时间，但在实际应用中显式依赖它往往并不必要。

summary: Quantum-inspired algorithms emulate quantum mechanical principles, such as, superposition, interference, and probabilistic amplitude evolution, on classical hardware by representing candidate solutions as qubit vectors and evolving them through rotation-gate operators. This approach offers higher optimization performance without physical qubits, and has been shown to achieve order-of-magnitude speedups (10--80$\times$) over traditional solvers on combinatorial, high-dimensional NP-hard problems.   A critical barrier to adoption, however, is the lack of a unified execution framework that delivers both algorithmic performance and hardware portability. We present \textbf{Cross-Backend Quantum Inspired Evolutionary Optimizer (QIEO)}, the runtime core of BQP's BQPhy solver, which addresses this gap through a \emph{single-source-of-truth} architecture. One C++ implementation of the QIEO algorithm is compiled once per hardware target and exposed to multiple high-level languages via thin binding layers. The framework dispatches to CPU (sequential), OpenMP~5 (multi-core), CUDA (NVIDIA), and HIP (AMD) backends at runtime, adapting kernels to each device's memory hierarchy and warp/wavefront execution model.   The framework's real-world utility is validated through binding demonstrations that share the identical C++ runtime. BQPhy's Python library is demonstrated on a neural network hyperparameter optimisation achieving 88.60\% test accuracy on MNIST. BQPhy's MATLAB's Toolkit is tested on wind farm layout optimisation attaining $365\,399 \pm 4\,552$~MWh/yr, which is statistically indistinguishable from particle swarm optimisation and $+7.6\%$ above genetic algorithms on a 32-variable constrained engineering problem. The Julia package tackles the Lotka--Volterra parameter estimation where BQPhy replaces native Julia solvers on the same residual, cutting mean SSE by $2.1\times$.
title: Cross-Backend QIEO: Universal Runtime Portability across OpenMP5, CUDA, HIP, and Multi-Language Interfaces
title_translated: 跨后端量子启发式进化优化器：OpenMP5、CUDA、HIP 与多语言接口间的通用运行时可移植性
summary_translated: 量子启发算法通过将候选解表示为量子比特向量并使用旋转门算子演化，模拟量子力学原理（如叠加、干涉和概率振幅演化）在经典硬件上运行。该方法无需物理量子比特即可实现更高优化性能，在组合型高维NP难问题上相比传统求解器实现了数量级的加速（10–80倍）。然而，采用的一大障碍是缺乏统一的执行框架，无法同时兼顾算法性能与硬件可移植性。本文提出	extbf{跨后端量子启发式进化优化器（QIEO）}，作为BQP的BQPhy求解器的运行时核心，通过单一真实源架构解决这一问题。QIEO算法仅需一次C++实现编译即可针对不同硬件目标部署，并通过轻量绑定层暴露给多种高级语言。该框架可在运行时调度至CPU（串行）、OpenMP 5（多核）、CUDA（NVIDIA）和HIP（AMD）后端，自适应地适配各设备的内存层次结构及波前/波束执行模型。通过共享相同C++运行时的绑定演示验证了框架的实际效用：BQPhy的Python库在神经网络超参数优化任务中达到MNIST测试准确率88.60%；MATLAB工具包在风电场布局优化中实现365,399 ± 4,552 MWh/年的发电量，与粒子群优化统计无差异，且比遗传算法高出7.6%，适用于32变量约束工程问题；Julia包用于Lotka-Volterra参数估计，BQPhy替换原生Julia求解器，在相同残差下使平均SSE降低2.1倍。

summary: Looped transformers reuse weights across recurrence steps, making low-bit quantization especially attractive. We identify two distinct failure modes of standard post-training quantization. On Huginn-3.5B, per-channel INT4 fails primarily at the non-residual loop-entry adapter, while quantizing the residual core is much less damaging. We call this feedback exposure: a quantized layer perturbs the recurrent state without an identity path, and the resulting error is fed back at later steps. Controlled experiments on linear filters and Mamba state-space models show that feedback exposure also occurs outside transformers. Grouped INT4 reveals a separate failure, calibration blindness: our one-step GPTQ baseline builds its Hessian from step-0 activations, leaving input directions used later in the recurrence nearly unweighted. Across nine checkpoints from seven looped architectures, one-step GPTQ is worse than round-to-nearest (RTN) on the primary task metric for five checkpoints. Accumulating the GPTQ Hessian across recurrence steps outperforms both one-step GPTQ and RTN on all nine checkpoints and recovers bf16-level accuracy on Huginn. These results separate two questions for PTQ on looped models: where quantization error enters the recurrence, and which states calibration sees.
title: Quantizing Looped Transformers: Feedback Exposure and Calibration Blindness

title_translated: 循环Transformer的量化：反馈暴露与校准盲区
summary_translated: 循环Transformer通过在递归步骤间复用权重，使得低比特量化尤为吸引人。我们识别出标准事后量化（PTQ）的两种不同失效模式。在Huginn-3.5B模型上，按通道INT4量化主要在非残差循环入口适配器处失败，而量化残差核心则影响较小。我们称之为反馈暴露：量化层扰动递归状态但缺乏恒等路径，导致误差在后续步骤中被反复反馈。在线性滤波器和Mamba状态空间模型上的受控实验表明，反馈暴露现象也存在于Transformer之外。分组INT4揭示了另一种失效模式——校准盲区：我们的单步GPTQ基线从第0步激活值构建海森矩阵，导致递归后期使用的输入方向几乎未被加权。在来自七个循环架构的九个检查点中，单步GPTQ在五个检查点上劣于四舍五入取整（RTN）方法。将GPTQ海森矩阵累积到整个递归过程后，其在所有九个检查点上均优于单步GPTQ和RTN，并在Huginn模型上恢复了bf16级别的精度。这些结果区分了循环模型PTQ中的两个关键问题：量化误差进入递归的位置，以及校准所感知的状态。

summary: This paper proposes an architecture for equipping large language models (LLMs) with audio-understanding capabilities without fine-tuning their weights. The proposed symbiotic architecture employs an injector module that writes audio-conditioned vectors directly into the target LLM's short-term memory, i.e., the key-value (KV) cache, enabling the LLM to behave as an audio language model (ALM). The architectural advantages are twofold. First, it improves the scalability of ALMs: because the proposed method bypasses the LLM during audio injection, the injection cost is governed by the injector width rather than the backbone width, and can therefore scale more slowly than the cost of full-backbone prefilling. Second, since the training scheme does not update the LLM weights, the original capabilities of the LLM are preserved without the risk of degradation from fine-tuning. The effectiveness of the proposed method is evaluated on both audio-understanding tasks (automatic speech recognition, audio question answering, and acoustic scene classification) and text-only tasks. We confirm that, while activating fewer parameters during audio prefilling, our architecture outperforms the conventional method with a frozen LLM and approaches the performance of a fine-tuned ALM, all while preserving the backbone LLM's original text-only task performance by construction.
title: Symbiotic Architecture for Post-Hoc Audio Extension of Frozen Language Models

summary_translated: 本文提出一种无需微调权重即可赋予大型语言模型（LLMs）音频理解能力的架构。所提出的共生架构采用注入模块，将音频条件向量直接写入目标LLM的短期记忆（即键值缓存），使LLM能够表现为音频语言模型（ALM）。该架构具有双重优势：首先，提升了ALMs的可扩展性：由于该方法在音频注入阶段绕过了LLM，注入成本由注入器宽度决定而非主干宽度，因此可随主干规模增长更缓慢；其次，由于训练方案不更新LLM权重，原始LLM的能力得以保留，避免了微调带来的退化风险。所提方法在音频理解任务（自动语音识别、音频问答、声学场景分类）和纯文本任务上均进行了评估。结果表明，尽管在音频预填充过程中激活的参数较少，该架构仍优于传统冻结LLM方法，并接近微调ALM的性能，同时通过设计保证了主干LLM在原始纯文本任务上的性能不变。

summary: "System One" decision models such as TypeSafe's Jev and its open counterpart Laya answer typed questions about a text in a single forward pass with calibrated probabilities, but they cannot ask for missing information: when a first message does not say what separates two departments, they guess. We present LAVOIR (Laya with Value-Of-Information Routing), which places the candidate pieces of missing information (slots) in the input next to the answer options, so that one forward pass returns both the decision distribution and, for every slot, the expected gain in the probability of the correct decision if the user were asked about it. VOI targets need no human labels: gold decisions come from schema rules, an LLM only verbalizes messages and answers, a model from another family checks every text, and pairing each message with several profiles makes regression on realized gains estimate the expected gain. A Gini-impurity cap bounds the predicted value by what a calibrated model can still gain. In a controlled study, decisions on seen schemas are statistically indistinguishable from the Bayes ceiling. The final model's question policy matches a greedy oracle VOI policy on seen schemas (AUC 0.799 vs. 0.797), and with at most 0.5 questions per conversation it is 14.1 points more accurate than never asking. On real ABCD conversations, one real exchange raises accuracy by 8.3 points where LAVOIR asks and leaves it unchanged where it does not; on SGD the cap lowers the asking rate from 93% to 8.6%. On Laya's twelve benchmarks LAVOIR is above Laya's reported scores on seven, and it answers a question in 31 ms (median, GH200).
title: LAVOIR: Teaching a Single-Pass Decision Encoder When and What to Ask with Amortized Value of Information

title_translated: LAVOIR：通过近似信息价值教学单次决策编码器何时何地提问
summary_translated: “系统一”类决策模型（如TypeSafe的Jev及其开源对应物Laya）可通过单次前向传播以校准概率回答关于文本的类型化问题，但无法主动询问缺失信息：当第一条消息未说明两个部门的区别时，它们会进行猜测。我们提出LAVOIR（Laya with Value-Of-Information Routing），将待补充的缺失信息（槽位）置于输入中与答案选项并列，使得一次前向传播不仅能返回决策分布，还能为每个槽位输出：若用户被询问该槽位，正确决策概率的预期提升。VOI目标无需人工标注：真实决策来自模式规则，仅由LLM口头描述消息和答案，另一家族模型检查每条文本，将每条消息与多个资料配对，通过实际收益回归估算预期收益。使用基尼不纯度上限限制预测价值，确保不超过校准模型仍能获得的最大增益。在控制研究中，对已见模式的决策与贝叶斯上限统计无差异。最终模型的问题策略在已见模式上与贪婪最优VOI策略匹配（AUC 0.799 vs. 0.797），且每对话最多提问0.5次时，比从不提问高出14.1分。在真实ABCD对话中，一次真实交互使准确率提升8.3分（LAVOIR提问时），未提问时保持不变；在SGD上，该上限将提问率从93%降至8.6%。在Laya的十二个基准测试中，LAVOIR在七个上超过Laya报告得分，且单次问答耗时31毫秒（中位数，GH200）。

summary: Large language model email assistants are particularly vulnerable to indirect prompt injection because untrusted email content can be retrieved into the model context and influence subsequent tool use. Existing prompt injection detectors mainly formulate this problem as binary malicious text classification, which overlooks the important factor that harmful agent behavior often arises through a sequence of stages. We propose a detection framework that models this attack chain by combining a text detector, verifiers specific to each stage, explicit rule-based risk signals, user intent and action consistency analysis, and a logistic decision policy. To support this framework, we derive attack chain labels from prompt injection datasets, evaluate the proposed framework under random splits, temporal phase transfer, conditional stage transfer, cross-dataset transfer, and conduct ablation studies on multiple benchmarks. Results show that random train test splits substantially overestimate robustness under distribution shift, while later tool argument stages are more predictable than earlier stages in the framework. We also show that training on harmless emails that resemble attacks helps reduce false alarms while preserving the ability to detect real attacks. Across five binary benchmarks, our framework achieves a mean F1 score of 0.406 under the strict threshold setting policy, compared with 0.216 for the strongest of five pretrained detectors evaluated without additional training. These results highlight the value of combining attack stage predictions with checks for conflicts between the user's request and instructions in retrieved emails. Our experiments also demonstrate the importance of training with challenging benign examples to balance attack detection and false alarms.
title: Prompt Injection Detection for Email Agents Through Attack Chain Modeling

title_translated: 基于攻击链建模的邮件智能体提示注入检测
summary_translated: 大型语言模型邮件助手特别容易受到间接提示注入攻击，因为不可信的邮件内容可能被引入模型上下文，进而影响后续工具使用。现有提示注入检测器主要将此问题形式化为二元恶意文本分类，忽略了有害代理行为通常通过一系列阶段逐步形成的重要因素。我们提出一种检测框架，通过结合文本检测器、各阶段特定验证器、显式基于规则的风险信号、用户意图与操作一致性分析，以及逻辑决策策略来建模攻击链。为支持该框架，我们从提示注入数据集中推导出攻击链标签，在随机划分、时间阶段迁移、条件阶段迁移、跨数据集迁移以及多个基准的消融研究中评估该框架。结果显示，随机训练测试划分严重夸大了分布偏移下的鲁棒性，而后期工具参数阶段比早期阶段更具可预测性。我们还发现，在类似攻击的无害邮件上进行训练有助于减少误报，同时保持检测真实攻击的能力。在五个二元基准上，我们的框架在严格阈值设置下平均F1得分为0.406，远高于五个预训练检测器中最强者（未经额外训练时F1为0.216）。这些结果凸显了结合攻击阶段预测与用户请求与检索邮件指令之间冲突检查的价值。实验也证明，使用具有挑战性的良性样本进行训练对于平衡攻击检测与误报至关重要。

summary: On Jan. 30, 2026, the U.S. Department of Justice released a mixed-media collection concerning Jeffrey Epstein, including about three million pages of PDFs. We describe the Epstein Files Engine, an A.I. agent The New York Times deployed to investigate the files. The Engine translated reporter questions into Google BigQuery SQL queries across three corpora: Epstein-related releases, the Times's archive and external, Epstein-related news headlines. It used an LLM to plan queries and returned citation-rich answers a reporter could verify and trust. More than 100 journalists used the Engine, and it contributed to at least 20 published stories. We report how reporters queried it and describe Diff, our text-and-visual duplicate matching method that amplified novelty signals and allowed the Engine to surface genuinely new information. We argue that newsroom agents serve newsrooms best not as autonomous writers, but as interfaces to source material and institutional knowledge.
title: Epstein Files Engine: Agentic Search for Investigative Journalism
